policy.KEEP_never_touched: all added/special/unused tokens (6,415 incl. <start_of_turn>, <end_of_turn>, <bos>, <unusedN>, html markup), byte tokens <0xHH>, tokens with no letter (digits, punctuation, symbols, emoji, whitespace pieces), Latin, Ethiopic, Arabic, Greek (science/LaTeX letters), Tifinagh, N'Ko, Vai, Adlam, Osmanya, Bamum, and any mixed token that contains a KEEP script
policy.re_use_rule: only LEAF tokens (not an input of any merge) of FREE scripts; priority by script order, then id descending; first 16000 form the pool
